notes: Outline redrawn 2026-11-20 under the owner's new rules (edge on paper between the innermost rule and the first map ink; ruled boxes at the margin are notches; no holes; legend/title blocks, compass roses and SECTION badges go in 'remove'). Sides: placed from pixel profiles across the frame at every px along each side (outer bar, white hairline, thin inner rule), on the first 1-2 px of paper inside the thin rule's inner edge, never on the rule or in the hairline; where map ink lies within a few px of the rule the edge runs in the paper gap between them, and where map ink truly touches the rule it follows the rule's inner edge (estimated from the neighbouring clean stretches and the bar's outer edge). Points every 15-50 px, so the bowed rules are followed. Corners (rule 2): the inner edge of the innermost (thin) arc was traced from the scan (circle fit to the measured edge, then the edge measured along the outline), the outline ~1-2 px inside it; where the arc leaves the side rule (a short stub inside the rule) the outline goes round the stub, so the stub stays outside. Kind (b): on the left side (y ~550-2900) the solid black and hatched blocks west of the Embarcadero run into the 3-4 px thin rule with no paper between, so the outline sits on the first column inside the rule and whole 50-px stretches lie on block ink; along the bottom (x ~480-1700) the hatched blocks touch the bottom rule; on the right (y ~1700-1830) the black pier shapes touch the right rule; at the bottom-left corner blocks and street lines cross the arc and are cut at its inner edge, and one block sits on the arc where it meets the bottom rule (x ~435-460). A 3x3 px speck at (354, 433), 5 px inside the rule at the top-left arc's junction, is left outside (doubt: speck or broken ornament; no map line runs to it). remove: (1) the CITY & COUNTY ... ZONE MAP title, LEGEND and scale-bar block (top right, rectangle on open bay paper); (2) the SECTION 8 badge (octagon, clear of the top-right arc); (3) the compass rose with its two long arrows (elongated outline along the arrows, clear of the C and O of BAY OF SAN FRANCISCO). All three kept unchanged from the former holes. Deleted hole: the 'Join Sec. 9' cross-reference inside the frame stays map (rule 4). No ruled box at the margin. 'Join Sec. 1' and 'Join Sec. 7' print outside the frame. BAY OF SAN FRANCISCO, the pier lettering and the dotted box round Mission Rock (a real island, drawn with its zoning) stay map.
